## What that model needs from its parts

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- Carry the uncertainty the whole way, from the unobserved process to every
  observed stream
- Keep transmission, priors and observation separate, and let a model nest
  inside another model
- Let a component carry its own priors, and stay useful on its own
- Specify once, then simulate and fit the same object

::: {.callout-note}
The argument for joint models is the 16:45 talk in this room.
:::
:::
